title: SOME/IP: improve uniqueness of segments
description:
Instead of generic addresses and ports, use characteristics of the
SOME/IP protocol (service ID, method ID, client ID, session ID, message
type, major version) to classify segments of its communications.

Closes #18880

notes.body:
Good catch, I missed the Session ID and Client ID back then. :disappointed: 

However, you need to also take the IP and Port into account or else you will create a new problem, since different service instances are only differentiated by different IPs and Ports. The VLAN might be also good to check.
Based on #18880, the IPs and ports aren't guaranteed to be different either. I can add that back in with some extra work, though.
possible that I misunderstood addresses_ports_reassembly_table_functions back then.
